package com.musicplayer.data.repository

import com.musicplayer.data.local.filemanager.FileItem
import com.musicplayer.data.local.filemanager.FileManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.jaudiotagger.audio.AudioFileIO
import org.jaudiotagger.tag.FieldKey
import java.io.File
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

data class TagFields(
    val title: String = "",
    val artist: String = "",
    val album: String = "",
    val year: String = "",
    val trackNumber: String = "",
)

@Singleton
class FileRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val fileManager: FileManager,
) {
    fun getRootPath(): String = fileManager.getRootPath()

    suspend fun listDirectory(path: String): List<FileItem> = fileManager.listDirectory(path)

    suspend fun renameFile(path: String, newName: String): Result<String> =
        fileManager.renameFile(path, newName)

    suspend fun deleteFile(path: String): Result<Unit> =
        fileManager.deleteFile(path)

    suspend fun createDirectory(parentPath: String, name: String): Result<String> =
        fileManager.createDirectory(parentPath, name)

    suspend fun copyFile(sourcePath: String, destDirPath: String): Result<String> =
        fileManager.copyFile(sourcePath, destDirPath)

    suspend fun moveFile(sourcePath: String, destDirPath: String): Result<String> =
        fileManager.moveFile(sourcePath, destDirPath)

    suspend fun readTags(path: String): TagFields = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            val tag = AudioFileIO.read(File(path)).tag
            TagFields(
                title = tag?.getFirst(FieldKey.TITLE) ?: "",
                artist = tag?.getFirst(FieldKey.ARTIST) ?: "",
                album = tag?.getFirst(FieldKey.ALBUM) ?: "",
                year = tag?.getFirst(FieldKey.YEAR) ?: "",
                trackNumber = tag?.getFirst(FieldKey.TRACK) ?: "",
            )
        }.getOrDefault(TagFields())
    }

    suspend fun writeTags(path: String, fields: TagFields): Result<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            val audioFile = AudioFileIO.read(File(path))
            val tag = audioFile.tagOrCreateAndSetDefault
            tag.setField(FieldKey.TITLE, fields.title)
            tag.setField(FieldKey.ARTIST, fields.artist)
            tag.setField(FieldKey.ALBUM, fields.album)
            tag.setField(FieldKey.YEAR, fields.year)
            tag.setField(FieldKey.TRACK, fields.trackNumber)
            audioFile.commit()
        }
    }
}

Here are the steps to test each feature from Session 8, without triggering a full rescan of your library.

## Build & Install

1. Connect your phone, run **Run > Run 'app'** (or `Shift+F10`) to build and install. The existing Room database and scanned library are preserved on reinstall (as long as you don't uninstall first).

---

## 1. Files tab in bottom nav

- Open the app. You should now see a **four-item bottom bar**: Home | Library | Files | Settings.
- Tap **Files**. The File Explorer screen opens at your storage root (`/storage/emulated/0`).

---

## 2. MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission

- If this is the first time opening the Files tab after the reinstall, you will see the **"Storage Access Required"** rationale dialog.
- Tap **Open Settings**, grant "All files access" for the app, then press Back. The file list should appear immediately (the screen re-checks on resume).
- To re-test: go to **Settings > Apps > MusicPlayer > Permissions**, revoke "Files and media" / "All files access", then re-open the Files tab.

---

## 3. Directory browsing & breadcrumbs

- Tap into any folder — the breadcrumb row at the top updates.
- Tap a breadcrumb label to jump directly back to that level.
- Tap the **↑ Up** button in the bottom bar to go up one level.

---

## 4. Multi-select (long-press)

- **Long-press** any item — it becomes selected (highlighted). The toolbar switches to selection mode showing Copy / Cut / **Delete** / Clear icons.
- Long-press additional items to add them to the selection.
- Tap **Delete** (trash icon) to batch-delete all selected items. A Snackbar appears if any delete fails.
- Tap **Clear** (✕) to exit selection without deleting.

---

## 5. Cut / Copy / Paste / Rename / New Folder

These were already wired in previous sessions; the fixes here were bug corrections (errors now show in a **Snackbar** at the bottom instead of being silently swallowed).

- **Rename**: tap ⋮ > Rename on any item, enter a new name, confirm.
- **Copy/Cut + Paste**: select an item, tap Copy or Cut in the toolbar, navigate to a destination folder, tap the **Paste** clipboard icon that appears in the toolbar.
- **New Folder**: tap the folder-plus icon in the bottom bar.

---

## 6. Play an audio file on tap

- Navigate to any folder containing MP3/FLAC/etc. files (audio files are tinted with your accent color).
- **Tap** an audio file directly — the Mini Player should appear at the bottom and the track should start playing immediately.
- You can also tap ⋮ > **Play** from the dropdown menu.

---

## 7. Edit Tags (the main new feature) — without full rescan

This is the key part where you can avoid a full rescan:

1. Navigate to a folder with a FLAC (or MP3) file.
2. Tap ⋮ on the file > **Edit Tags**.
3. The bottom sheet opens. Wait one moment for tags to load (spinner briefly).
4. Change the **Title** field (e.g., add " (Test)" at the end).
5. Tap **Save**. The sheet closes and a background scan is triggered — but this is `LibraryScanWorker` which scans **all** files via MediaStore. See note below.
6. Navigate to the **Library** screen. Within ~10–30 seconds (depending on library size) the updated title should appear.

> **Important note on the rescan:** `LibraryScanWorker` calls `MusicRepository.scanLibrary()` which runs a full MediaStore query. On a large library this takes time, but it runs in the background via WorkManager and does **not** block the UI. You do not need to wait for it — just go to the Library screen a minute later and pull-to-refresh or navigate away and back. The Room DB will reflect the new tags once the worker finishes.
>
> If you want to verify the tag was written correctly *before* the scan completes: re-open Edit Tags on the same file — you should see the new title already loaded from the file's actual tags.

---

## 8. Move a folder and verify library update (integration test from the spec)

1. Long-press a **folder** of albums to select it.
2. Tap **Cut** in the toolbar.
3. Navigate to a different location and tap **Paste**.
4. Wait for `LibraryScanWorker` to finish (~30–60 seconds on a 10k library).
5. Go to **Library > Albums** — the albums from the moved folder should still be present (new paths scanned in), and old paths should be gone.

---

## Verifying errors surface correctly
